name: Newport Cliff Walk
where: Newport, Rhode Island · Memorial Blvd to Bailey's Beach
blurb: A 3.5-mile shoreline path between the Atlantic and the back lawns of Newport's Gilded Age mansions, paved in the north and rocky around Rough Point.
status: Partly closed: the stretch between Narragansett Ave and Webster St (just south of the Forty Steps) has been closed since a 2022 collapse; a signed street detour goes around it, repairs are expected 2027–2029, and the rest of the walk is open sunrise to sunset.

trails.name: Cliff Walk to the Forty Steps
